function.name: list_dir
function.description: Returns the contents of a given folder (the cwd or relative to the cwd). Returns all files and folders from the queried directory and all files and subfolders with a limit from child directories

dir.description: Relative path to the cwd of the folder you want to explore (use . to get the contents of the cwd)

depth.description: Maxmimum depth you want to explore the given folder (default is 3 maximum is 5)
